insight: Open-source and Docker-self-hostable, unlike most closed agent-browser APIs — the same sandbox runs locally or in Steel's cloud.
name: Steel
tagline: Open-source browser API for AI agents and apps.
description: A batteries-included headless-browser sandbox that lets AI agents automate the web without managing browser infrastructure. Steel handles sessions, cookies, proxy rotation, CAPTCHA solving, and page-to-markdown/screenshot/PDF conversion behind a single API, built on Puppeteer and the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Run the open-source image locally via Docker or use Steel Cloud's managed browser fleet.

modelSupport.notes: Browser infrastructure — pair it with any agent framework or model.
